# MyNigeriaGuide

> MyNigeriaGuide is an independent Nigerian information website. It helps people find Nigerian movies, understand services, plan trips within Nigeria, and explore jobs and career pathways. It is not a government agency, recruiter, ticket seller, or payment processor.

Website: https://mynigeriaguide.com/

## Four editorial sections

- [Movies & Entertainment](https://mynigeriaguide.com/entertainment): Nigerian film and series information, cast, cinemas, and links to legitimate viewing sources.
- [Services](https://mynigeriaguide.com/services): Practical Nigerian public and private service guides, requirements, fees where verified, procedures, and links to responsible official providers.
- [Tour Nigeria](https://mynigeriaguide.com/explore): Nigerian cities, attractions, destinations, events, and travel-planning guides.
- [Jobs & Careers](https://mynigeriaguide.com/jobs): Nigerian recruitment information, employer career portals, application guidance, and dated opportunity status.

## Source quality and corrections

- [About](https://mynigeriaguide.com/about): What MyNigeriaGuide covers and its independent status.
- [Editorial policy](https://mynigeriaguide.com/editorial-policy): Source verification, accuracy, and publication practices.
- [Corrections](https://mynigeriaguide.com/corrections): How to report inaccurate or outdated information.
- [Contact](https://mynigeriaguide.com/contact): How to reach the publisher.

## Content discovery

- [XML sitemap index](https://mynigeriaguide.com/sitemap-index.xml): Canonical, publicly indexable pages by section.
- [Verified updates feed](https://mynigeriaguide.com/updates.xml): Published changes to selected services and official guidance.

For fees, deadlines, opening hours, vacancies, and application requirements, read the individual canonical page's verification date and follow its primary-source link before acting. Avoid treating older summaries as live availability.

This optional file is a navigation aid, not an authorization to reuse third-party material, a substitute for robots.txt, or a guarantee of inclusion in any AI search answer.
